summary.zh: 本次更新为你带来全新的终端输出查看器、技能调用卡片和设置中的使用量标签页，同时修复了对话流中内部标记可能泄漏到聊天的问题，并优化了更新流程的稳定性。
summary.en: This update brings a new terminal output viewer, skill invocation cards, and a usage tab in settings, while fixing a potential leak of internal markers in chat and improving update flow stability.

summary.zh: 在右侧栏新增只读终端输出查看器，可实时查看命令执行输出，支持安全停止和聊天卡片跳转。
summary.en: A read-only terminal output viewer in the right rail lets you see real-time command execution output, with safe stop and chat-card navigation.

details.zh: 输出采用批式实时展示，支持 ANSI 安全预览，并在断线时自动重连或补拉。
details.en: Output is batched live with ANSI-safe preview, auto-reconnects, and gap recovery on disconnection.

details.zh: 每条命令执行会渲染为独立卡片，并显示真实终端状态。
details.en: Each command execution is rendered as a standalone card with real terminal status.

sources.title: feat: terminal output viewer, card interaction rework, skill invocation cards, usage tab

summary.zh: 技能调用现在以卡片形式显示在对话中的真实调用位置，并带有清晰的参数说明。
summary.en: Skill invocations now appear as cards at their exact call position in the chat, with clear parameter semantics.

details.zh: 卡片支持用户提示词参数，并针对隐藏输入显示占位符。
details.en: Cards support user-prompt parameters and show placeholders for hidden inputs.

sources.title: feat: terminal output viewer, card interaction rework, skill invocation cards, usage tab

title.zh: 设置中的使用量标签页

summary.zh: 在设置中新增“使用量”标签页，通过光标提示图展示用量情况。
summary.en: A new Usage tab in settings shows your usage with cursor tip charts.

details.zh: 更直观地了解 token 等资源消耗趋势。
details.en: Get a clearer view of resource consumption trends such as tokens.

sources.title: feat: terminal output viewer, card interaction rework, skill invocation cards, usage tab

title.zh: 修复内部标记可能泄漏到聊天的问题
title.en: Fix potential leak of internal markers in chat

summary.zh: 修复了在工具循环中，多段模型生成时内部标记（如心情、思考）可能被当作普通文本显示的问题。
summary.en: Fixed an issue where internal markers (like mood/think tags) could be shown as normal text during multi-segment model generation in tool loops.

details.zh: 现在每次新的助手输出段都会重置标记解析状态，确保只识别段首的标记。
details.en: Marker parsing now re-arms per assistant segment, so only segment-leading markers are recognized.

details.zh: 同时修复了缓冲区内多个心情段可能互相覆盖的问题。
details.en: Also fixed an issue where multiple mood segments in the buffer could overwrite each other.

sources.title: fix(stream): re-arm leading internal mood/think opener per assistant segment

summary.zh: 修复了开发版无法找到更新配置的问题，并在安装过程中显示正确的状态，支持更新失败后重试。
summary.en: Fixed a dev-mode issue where the update config wasn't found, now shows correct status during install, and allows retry after update failure.

details.zh: 将 dev-app-update.yml 移至应用根目录，确保开发模式下可检测更新。
details.en: Moved dev-app-update.yml to app root so updates are found in dev mode.

details.zh: 关于页面在安装中显示专用状态，并提供失败重试按钮。
details.en: The About page shows a dedicated installing state and offers a retry button on failure.

sources.title: fix: address review findings from bbbce725

title.zh: 修复循环状态显示不同步

summary.zh: 修复了在 kickoff 处理较慢时，界面可能显示空闲而实际循环已在运行的问题，并确保循环目标重置时正确停止。
summary.en: Fixed a desync where the UI could show idle while the loop was actually running when kickoff was slow, and ensured the loop stops on target reset.

details.zh: 现在启动时立即发送运行状态，避免界面滞后。
details.en: Status is now emitted immediately on start to prevent UI lag.

details.zh: 当 kickoff 目标重置时，循环会停止，避免出现僵尸运行状态。
details.en: The loop stops on kickoff target reset, preventing zombie 'running' states.

summary.zh: 关于页面的布局和内容已重构，并新增了中文、英文、日文、韩文和繁体中文翻译。
summary.en: The About tab layout and content were reworked, with translations added for zh, en, ja, ko, and zh-TW.

details.zh: 界面显示会根据系统语言自动适配。
details.en: The UI now adapts to the system language automatically.
